answer: Fraud bounties can be designed to resist sybils. A report pays nothing until a validator from a disjoint pool corroborates it, and a bounty is split across all reports of one incident. Rewards form a terrace, not a flat rate: the first corroborated report earns full weight, duplicates a declining share. Puppet accounts form a nebula that the graph collapses into one cluster, so self-registered fakes yield one diluted share while the bond is forfeited. Authorship is matched too, so many reports from the same quill count once. Self-reporting becomes a net loss that widens with scale.
